🌸 Seasonal Guide: When to Visit Paris for Romance
days.description: Cherry blossoms in the Tuileries, outdoor café terraces reopen, pleasant 15–22°C weather. May and June are perfect — long daylight hours (sunset after 9 PM) give you golden evenings. Late April brings wisteria blooming on Montmartre buildings. Book accommodation 2–3 months ahead.
